name: Ear Worm #8
description:
A Gift of Worms is a Gift for you from Emil G Music.

Ear Worms, also known as Sticky Music or Stuck Song Syndrome are catchy, memorable pieces of music that continuously occupy a person's mind even after they are no longer being played. These reimagined holiday classics are musical memes that you just can’t get out of your head.

And the Ear Worms are cute too, adding to your holiday fun.

Happy Holidays

Recorded at Salt Spring Studios
Composed by Andrew Stark
Performed by Emil G Music
Mixed and Mastered by SpaDogs
Cover Art by SpaDogs

Quadraphonic is encoded using Involve Encode™ Surround Stereo down-mix & universal stereo audio format.
